## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. VXX NEUTRAL (VXX (1W: +0.41% | 1M: -4.47%) RECOVERY) and Stocks vs Bonds NEUTRAL (SPY (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION) confirm mixed momentum despite broad participation.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Broad equity participation supporting markets: Sector breadth 10/11 positive is constructive. Credit softness is a headwind as HYG (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -0.27%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -2.31%) BELOW TREND indicate HYG/LQD ↓ (credit stress rising); VXX RECOVERY shows short-term fear pick-up but 1M easing.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Duration pressure: TLT (1W: -0.17% | 1M: -3.77%) BELOW TREND implies yields ↑ rising. Dollar and other macro ratios are broadly neutral, leaving financial conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Cyclicals and commodity-exposed sectors leading: XLF (Financials proxy XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND) and XLE (XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength, while Tech lags with XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND; Style: Value/Cyclicals over Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US mixed: SPY (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.65%) CORRECTION. China outperforming on the month: FXI (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND, while EM (EEM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -6.39%) RECOVERY) shows regional divergence.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation uneven: ETHA (1W: +2.65% | 1M: +25.30%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +9.70%) CORRECTION show continued appetite, but ARKK (1W: -3.23% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND flags idiosyncratic selling.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Industrial and metals strength: CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND and PALL (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +8.83%) ABOVE TREND; Gold supportive as GLD (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy constructive: XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND and Brent BNO (1W: -1.22% | 1M: +16.33%) CORRECTION show month-long strength with short-term profit taking; Natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Financials and Energy both positive across timeframes (XLF ABOVE TREND, XLE ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: Major 1W vs 1M mismatches across SPY, IWM and EEM indicate MAJOR DIVERGENCE — keep regime calls muted.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposure (XLF, XLE, CPER) given broad sector participation; reduce exposure to lagging Tech (XLK) and thematic risk (ARKK); bonds remain under pressure as TLT BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XLF (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +0.72% | 1M: +7.89%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND, SOXX (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -17.43%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.24% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND, PALL (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +8.83%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: -1.75% | 1M: -13.96%) BELOW TREND, TAN (1W: -2.14% | 1M: -10.90%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX 20 (complacency pivot), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health inflection), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value rotation trigger).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with strong participation: Breadth 10/11 sectors positive alongside neutral risk ratios (VXX and Stocks vs Bonds NEUTRAL). Financials and Energy showing relative strength (XLF ABOVE TREND, XLE ABOVE TREND). Key risk is the MAJOR 1W vs 1M divergence across core ETFs (SPY, IWM, EEM) — monitor for a translation into volatility.
